🔥 क्या दुलकर सलमान की नई फिल्म मचाएगी बॉक्स ऑफिस पर गदर? 🎬

दुलकर सलमान अपनी आने वाली तेलुगू फिल्म Aakasamlo Oka Tara के लिए पूरी तरह तैयार हैं। 🌟

यह तेलुगू सिनेमा में दुलकर की चौथी फिल्म है और इस इंडस्ट्री में उनका सक्सेस रेट सौ प्रतिशत है। 📈

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, मीठी प्रेम कहानी वाली यह फिल्म भारत में पांच करोड़ रुपए के आसपास ओपनिंग कर सकती है। 💰

फिल्म में दुलकर ने कृष्णा नाम के समर्पित पति का किरदार निभाया है, जो अपनी पत्नी कल्पना को अंतरिक्ष यात्री बनाने के लिए हर संभव कोशिश करता है। 👩‍🚀

पवन सादिनेनी के निर्देशन में बनी इस फिल्म से सातविका एक्टिंग में डेब्यू कर रही हैं और इसमें श्रुति हासन भी नजर आएंगी। 🎥

जी.वी. प्रकाश कुमार का संगीत थिएटर्स तक ऑडियंस को खींचने में अहम भूमिका निभा सकता है। 🎵

यह प्रेरणादायक फिल्म बीस नवंबर को थिएटर्स में रिलीज होगी। 🗓️

क्या आपको लगता है कि यह फिल्म दुलकर के टॉप फाइव ओपनर्स में शामिल हो पाएगी? 🤔

ctx.title: Aakasamlo Oka Tara Box Office: Can It Enter Dulquer Salmaan’s Top 5 Openers In India?
ctx.summary:
Dulquer Salmaan is gearing up for the release of Aakasamlo Oka Tara. It marks his 4th Telugu film. But can it make his top 5 biggest openers in India? 
 The post  Aakasamlo Oka Tara Box Office: Can It Enter Dulquer Salmaan’s Top 5 Openers In India?  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Dulquer Salmaan is gearing up for the release of his film, Aakasamlo Oka Tara. The upcoming Telugu film marks Dulquer’s fourth film in the language. He has a success rate of 100% in the Telugu film industry. He started his journey in Telugu cinema with the film Mahanati, followed by Sita Ramam and Lucky Baskhar. All three films received immense love from audiences and performed well at the box office. So, can Aakasamlo Oka Tara continue Dulquer’s winning streak?
Dulquer Salmaan’s previous release was the Malayalam film I’m Game. It was touted as the actor’s homecoming after 3 years. However, the film failed to impress audiences and had an underwhelming run at the box office. The actor is now looking to turn things around for himself in 2026 with Aakasamlo Oka Tara .
Given the nature of the film, Dulquer Salmaan’s sweet love story can open in the range of 5 crore in India. The actor and his team are going all out to promote the film and ensure that it receives the love it deserves. Additionally, Dulquer’s recent releases have proven that despite his bad luck at the Mollywood box office, his fan following remains strong. While Aakasamlo Oka Tara may not be his biggest opening ever, it could enter his top 5, beating Kaantha.
Dulquer Salmaan and his team are leaving no stone unturned to promote the film. Directed by Pavan Sadineni, the film marks Satvika’s acting debut. The film also features music by GV Prakash Kumar, who has proven to be a magician in this space. The music can also play a major role in driving audiences to theaters.
Dulquer Salmaan plays Krishna, a devoted husband who goes to any and all lengths to fulfill his wife Kalpana’s dream. His wife wishes to become an astronaut. Krishna puts all his efforts into educating his wife and helping her achieve her big dreams. The film also stars Shruti Haasan, who acts as a catalyst in Kalpana’s journey towards her dream. The inspirational film will hit theaters on November 20.
